result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: the last cuisine chip and a restaurant card title are cut off, and the popular-now list appears cropped at the bottom.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the name 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels leave enough padding or peek so titles remain fully readable, or wrap/truncate with ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The cuisine filter chips overflow the screen; the last visible chip ('Healthy') is cut off and the next chip is only partially shown.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or fade, or allow the chip row to scroll with a fully visible last item.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards are not hidden behind it.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar appears to highlight Profile while the screen is the Home feed, which can look like a wrong selected state.
issues.suggestion: Keep the Home tab selected when showing the home/delivery feed.
